svg.title: Inside the frame that was pinned first
svg.desc: A long block with a stepped slot along its deck and three mouths in its side, each with a tray. Round the far tray stands a dashed teal frame, held on a rail by a teal pin; the narrow block that came out inside it glows magenta. A wide block has come out into the near tray, where no frame was, and stays dark.
